Address Search
fields.description: Google answers every address lookup: new leads, clinic pins and Near Me.
Two-letter code, such as IN, that address search keeps to. Blank searches everywhere.

Map Display
fields.description: Who draws each map. Google needs a saved server key and the Location::Google::capture flag.
Draws the small map on task cards. Blank uses OpenStreetMap.

fields.description: How close the small map sits to the pin. Blank uses 16.

fields.description: Draws the larger map in task pop-ups. Blank uses Google while a key is saved.

Route Planning
fields.description: Orders a rep's visits for today on Near Me, under My day.

fields.label: Route Order
fields.description: Blank is straight line, at no cost. Google Routes orders by road, billed once per plan; it needs the Routes API on the server key.

fields.description: Visits on these lead groups must be logged near the clinic pin, while the Location::Google::capture flag is on.
Each row sets a lead group and how close a visit must be. Empty checks none.
